## business_data_dashboard

> Light-theme analytics dashboard mockup with KPI tiles and two illustrative charts.

**Artifact:** `dashboard`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/business/_vars_examples/dashboard_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A light-theme analytics dashboard mockup titled "Customer Success — Executive Overview", framed for the Apr 2026 (month-to-date) reporting window. The layout reads as a real product screenshot: a top app-bar with the title and period selector, a row of four KPI cards, and two side-by-side chart panels occupying the lower two-thirds.
[2. Action] The mockup must communicate "this is a working product" at a glance: KPI cards present headline numbers with their labels; the two charts are illustrative shapes (a smooth area chart and a simple bar chart) used as visual stand-ins, never decorated with fabricated tick values. Hierarchy guides the eye from title → KPI row → charts.
[3. Scene] Pure light-theme product surface. Off-white canvas with a faint cool-grey panel beneath the cards. No external setting, no laptop bezel, no browser chrome — the rendered image IS the dashboard surface.
[4. Composition] 16:9 frame. Top 8% reserved for the app-bar (title left, period right). Below the bar, four equal KPI cards span the full width with even gutters. The remaining ~62% of vertical space is split 60/40 between two chart panels (line/area on the left, bars on the right). Cards and panels have generous internal padding and consistent 16-pixel rounded corners.
[5. Style] Modern SaaS analytics aesthetic. Palette: paper white (#F7F8FB) ground, slate text (#1F2937), a single brand-blue accent (#2F67F6) for chart fills and KPI deltas, with a muted positive/negative pair (forest green / soft coral) reserved for trend arrows. Soft 4-pixel drop shadows under cards, rounded corners throughout, professional icon glyphs, no gradients on text, no photographic textures.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- title: "Customer Success — Executive Overview"
- period: "Period: Apr 2026 (month-to-date)"
- kpi_card_1: "Active accounts: 4,128 (+6.2%)"
- kpi_card_2: "Gross retention: 94.1%"
- kpi_card_3: "Avg time to value: 11 days"
- kpi_card_4: "Open critical tickets: 7"
- chart_label_1: "Weekly active accounts"
- chart_label_2: "Tickets by severity"

NO: watermarks, signatures, busy backgrounds, hand-drawn style, casual fonts, fake numerical axis values, clip-art icons, skeuomorphic glass, heavy 3D shadows
```

## business_linkedin_carousel

> LinkedIn "by the numbers" carousel cover slide with bold dark-mode typography.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1152x1440`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/business/_vars_examples/linkedin_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical 4:5 carousel cover for a "by the numbers" LinkedIn post. The cover frames a single headline at the top, a 2x2 grid of four standout statistics in the middle, and a short mission statement pinned to the bottom — engineered to hook a thumb-scroller in the first quarter-second.
[2. Action] The cover should feel like an editorial pull-quote: oversized typography commands attention, the four stat tiles deliver the proof, and the mission statement closes the hook. No motion suggestion; the slide reads as a static still that survives the feed.
[3. Scene] Dark studio field, near-black with a subtle vignette toward the edges. No photographic background. Optional faint dotted grid at very low contrast for structure.
[4. Composition] Generous outer margins (~6%). Top zone (≈22% height) holds the headline, set massive and tight-tracked. Middle zone (≈48%) holds four stat tiles in a 2x2 grid with thin divider rules between them. Bottom zone (≈18%) holds the mission line, smaller and lighter in weight, set above a tiny accent dot. Internal padding inside each stat tile keeps numbers from kissing the rules.
[5. Style] Dark-mode editorial. Palette: ink black (#0B0B0E) ground, paper- white type, a single high-saturation accent (electric lime or cyan) reserved for the four stat numerals. Big white sans-serif in a contemporary grotesque cut (Inter / Söhne / GT America feel), very tight margins, no decorative ornament, no photographic noise.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- headline: "Year One at Helio: by the numbers."
- stat_tile_1: "11,402 onboarded teams"
- stat_tile_2: "$1.8M saved for customers"
- stat_tile_3: "23 enterprise design partners"
- stat_tile_4: "Net Promoter Score 72"
- mission: "Building durable infrastructure for the next generation of climate-aware operators."

NO: watermarks, signatures, busy backgrounds, hand-drawn style, casual fonts, stock-photo overlays, emoji clutter, rainbow gradients, 3D text, drop shadows
```

## business_swot_card

> Four-quadrant SWOT analysis card for executive briefings and quarterly reviews.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1536x1024`, aspect `3:2`
**Demo vars:** `templates/business/_vars_examples/swot_acme.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A polished editorial SWOT analysis card for Acme Robotics covering Q1 of fiscal year 2026. The card is conceived as a single flat composition divided into four equally weighted quadrants, each representing one canonical SWOT dimension (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats), with a slim header band running across the top holding the company name and reporting period.
[2. Action] The viewer's eye should travel clockwise from the top-left strengths quadrant through opportunities, weaknesses, and threats, with each quadrant's content presented as crisp typeset bullets rather than decorative ornament. The header band acts as an anchor, fixing the composition's identity before the reader scans the matrix.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat, document-grade environment. No physical setting; this is a rendered analytic artifact. The background is a soft warm grey paper field with subtle paper grain, calibrated for print and on-screen legibility. No people, no props, no perspective.
[4. Composition] Strict 2x2 grid covering ~92% of the frame, with a 64-pixel gutter between quadrants and a 7%-tall header band above. Each quadrant has its own quiet category icon top-left, a label in small caps, and the analyst body copy below. Generous internal padding inside each quadrant. Color blocks are restrained and serve only to differentiate the four cells.
[5. Style] Editorial corporate aesthetic. Palette anchored on deep navy, slate, cool fog grey, and a single muted accent (oxidized teal). Type system: a humanist sans-serif for body copy, a slightly heavier display cut for the header. Minimalist flat treatment; no gradients, no glow, no drop shadows beyond a 1-pixel hairline rule.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- header: "Acme Robotics SWOT 2026 Q1"
- quadrant_strengths: "Strengths: vertical-integrated supply chain; 38% gross margin; tier-1 OEM contracts in 4 markets"
- quadrant_weaknesses: "Weaknesses: single-vendor lithium dependency; thin EMEA service network; aging ERP"
- quadrant_opportunities: "Opportunities: EU Right-to-Repair tailwind; warehouse-automation TAM growing 19% CAGR"
- quadrant_threats: "Threats: low-cost APAC entrants undercutting unit price; pending tariff revision on motor imports"

NO: watermarks, signatures, busy backgrounds, hand-drawn style, casual fonts, clip-art icons, stock-photo people, rainbow palettes
```
